metadata.methods_description: MEG neural recordings were acquired from 23 participants during viewing of 40 validated video clips designed to induce different emotional states. Head position information including 3D spatial coordinates for anatomical landmarks and Head Position Indicator (HPI) coils was measured prior to each recording session. Emotional responses were assessed using Self-Assessment Manikin (SAM) for valence and arousal, discrete emotion categories (PrEmo), and temporal highlight scene selections. A parallel online survey collected subjective emotional assessments from 500 participants for the same video stimuli. This dataset is derived from OpenNeuro dataset ds007640 (v1.0.1).
